about_the_game:
Climbing Mount Everest is a lifelong dream for many — but also the world’s most dangerous and costly challenge. Now, with this world's first life-size 1:1 replica of Everest game, you can live that dream without risking your life or breaking the bank!

What is EVEREST: Real Climbing Simulator?

EVEREST: Real Climbing Simulator is The world’s first 1:1 Mount Everest climbing game based on satellite mapping.

Core Features

  • 🗻 Authentic Everest Terrain – A fully restored, 100% accurate map of the mountain, from Base Camp to the summit.

  • 🌡️ Survival Systems – Manage food, stamina, water, and health under extreme conditions.

  • 🏍️ Casual or Hardcore – Take a snowmobile to cover dangerous ground more quickly, or switch to Hardcore Mode for the most authentic, step-by-step climbing challenge.

Your Goal

Climb Mount Everest — the 8,848-meter Roof of the World.
Feel free to record and share your climbing route with other users, and compete for the best climbing records.

From the Developers

This game was developed solely by two people. It is the last project we could finish after exhausting our development budget, so some ideas were left unfinished.

If the game receives enough support and sells well, we may be able to rebuild our team and polish it into the experience we originally envisioned.

Good morning, good afternoon, and good evening to all players.

As for the bears, wolves, and snowmobiles: at first, the game was intended to be a fully realistic Everest climbing simulation. But during testing we realized that, at the true climbing pace, a single ascent would take about 4 real-time days. Very few players could push through 4 days of endless snowfields without anything else happening.

So we decided to add animals and faster means of travel, allowing players to complete an ascent in their free time after work.

Of course, you can also choose the Hardcore Mode, where every single step is taken manually. But be prepared for a very long climb before you reach the summit.

We guarantee that Mount Everest in this game is recreated with 100% accuracy based on satellite mapping. That alone makes it a unique experience. When you finally reach the summit in-game, you will understand the breathtaking scale for yourself.
